summary: Implementation fully matches the saved plan for issue #441. A focused _persist_console_host_port helper in src/awf/cli/init_ops.py creates the env file (with parent dirs) when absent, replaces an existing AWF_CONSOLE_HOST_PORT in place (export/case-insensitive, no duplicate), appends with a guaranteed newline separator when the key is absent, and leaves AWF_CONSOLE_URL and other keys untouched. _resolve_start_bootstrap_inputs in src/awf/cli/start_commands.py persists in both the verified source-checkout branch (after legacy migration, into root .env) and the default-discovery branch (into the resolved read_env_file), only when console_port is not None and before settings resolution, while preserving the in-memory service_env injection. The --headless + --console-port guard still exits before persistence, and plain awf start (console_port=None) persists nothing. All 9 planned TDD scenarios are present: helper tests for create/replace/append/newline/export/case-insensitive/console-url in tests/unit/cli/test_init_ops_console_port_persist.py, and default-branch persist, no-op guard, source-checkout create, source-checkout preserve, plus the updated existing CLI override test in tests/unit/cli/test_start_commands.py. Scope stayed on the CLI/env-helper surface with no changes to config/bootstrap/status/smoke/doctor/Compose.
